title_sq: Okazzion!!! Tek Rrethi i Saukut, prane Liqenit Artificial, shitet Vilet 3 Kateshe
description_sq:
Tek Rrethi i Saukut, prane Liqenit Artificial, shitet Vilet 3 Kateshe, siperfaqe 629 m2 truall dhe 312 m2 ndertim , me certifikate pronesie, shkalle lidhese te brendshme, e mobiluar, cdo dhome me kondicioner, koridor qe lidh te gjitha dhomat, 3 tualete, 5 ballkone, verande, orientimi me diell.
Kati – 1 me siperfaqe 72,7 m2 sherben si garazh me mundesi parkimi per 3 makina
Kati perdhe i ngritur me 6 shkalle me siperfaqe 102,2 m2 organizohet me sallon, kuzhine me vete, dhome gjumi, tualet me dritare, 2 ballkone, verande (me siperfaqe 27,7m2), koridor shperndares
Kati pare banim me siperfaqe 94,3 organizohet ne 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete me dritare, koridor shperndares, 3 ballkone
Oborri me siperfaqe 510 m2 eshte i gjithi i gjelberuar me peme frutore dhe dekorative, i shtruar pjeserisht me pllake guri
Vila eshte e gjitha e sovatuar me grafiato, dyert druri dhe dritaret plastik tripleks te ndruara para 2 viteve, sistem kamerash
Vila ndodhet ne nje lagje te qete dhe te sigurte me te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme, me akses te shpejte ne autostrade dhe shume afer me qendren e Tiranes
Shitet 63,000,000 leke
title_en: Bargain!!! 3 Storey Villas for sale in the Sauk District, near the Artificial Lake
description_en: In the Sauk District, near the Artificial Lake, 3-Storey Villas for sale, 629 m2 of land and 312 m2 of construction, with ownership certificates, internal connecting stairs, furnished, each room with air conditioning, corridor connecting all rooms, 3 bathrooms, 5 balconies, veranda, sunny orientation. Floor - 1 with an area of 72.7 m2 serves as a garage with the possibility of parking for 3 cars Ground floor raised with 6 stairs with an area of 102.2 m2 is organized with a living room, separate kitchen, bedroom, bathroom with window, 2 balconies, veranda (with an area of 27.7 m2), distribution corridor First residential floor with an area of 94.3 is organized in 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms with windows, distribution corridor, 3 balconies The yard with an area of 510 m2 is all green with fruit and decorative trees, partially paved with stone tiles The villa is all plastered with graffiti, wooden doors and triplex plastic windows replaced 2 years ago, camera system The villa is located in a quiet and safe neighborhood with all the necessary facilities, with access to quickly on the highway and very close to the center of Tirana For sale 63,000,000 lek
